cim_eredeti: Artificial Intelligence 'singer' in Chinese pop band quits because she's pregnant: report
szoveg_eredeti:
by CHARLOTTE HAZARD | The National News Desk

WASHINGTON (TNND) — A “singer” in an Artificial Intelligence band announced she would be leaving the band because she is “pregnant.”

The band is called Baby Queen and even though it is an AI group, many fans didn’t know this information, according to a report from the Daily Mail.

The group’s singer is named Mity and the AI-generated individual put on social media that she found out she was pregnant and would be stepping back from the group.

Mity said that it was not an easy decision to make.

Baby Queen was reportedly created by K-pop fans who create storylines for the band.

The Daily Mail reports that the fans created this storyline as a “plot twist” because it was too hard to manage four different AI-band personas at once.

This story comes amid conversations about artificial intelligence and its impact on music and the entertainment industry.
